name: rust-intel
description: Marketplace for the rust-intel plugin — a living specification defending against the systematic mistakes LLMs make when writing Rust.

plugins.name: rust-intel
plugins.description: Defense against LLM Rust failure modes: 59 categories of bugs that survive rustc, clippy, and cargo test. Ships the rust-intel skill (auto-activates on Rust tasks) plus /rust-intel:audit, /rust-intel:fix, /rust-intel:plan commands and a fan-out project-audit workflow.
